اصطفقت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَفَقْتُ (iṣṭafaqtu) /isˤ.tˤa.faq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# اِصْطَفَقْتَ (iṣṭafaqta) /isˤ.tˤa.faq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# اِصْطَفَقْتِ (iṣṭafaqti) /isˤ.tˤa.faq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# اِصْطَفَقَتْ (iṣṭafaqat) /isˤ.tˤa.fa.qat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
